cards.text: Friend, last time the beast and the false prophet got thrown alive into the fiery lake (Revelation 19:20). Now John, the servant God showed this vision to, keeps watching (Revelation 1:1). He sees an angel coming down from heaven with a key, holding a great chain in his hand.

cards.question: The angel coming down from heaven holds the key to the ___.

cards.text: And that great chain is not for decoration, friend. The angel is about to use it on somebody.

cards.question: Who does the angel seize with that great chain?

cards.text: That dragon is the ancient serpent, the devil and Satan. FOUR names, friend, and I've only got two, one of them carved on my handle.

cards.question: The angel binds the dragon for ___ years.

cards.text: The angel throws him into the Abyss, shuts it and seals it over him. I spent years shut in a junk drawer, friend, but at least mine popped open every time somebody needed TAPE.

cards.question: Why is the Abyss shut and sealed over the dragon?

answers.text: So he cannot deceive the nations
So he cannot reach the heavens
So he cannot harm the angels

cards.question: Once the thousand years are complete, the dragon stays sealed in the Abyss for good.

cards.text: Then John sees thrones, and those seated on them have been given authority to judge. He also sees the souls of people who had been beheaded.

cards.question: Why had the people John sees been beheaded?

answers.text: For their refusal to pay taxes

cards.question: Along with those souls, John sees people who had not worshiped the beast or received its mark.
What happens to those souls and to the ones who refused the beast?

answers.text: They come to life and reign with Christ
They rest under the altar a while longer
They stand guard over the sealed Abyss

cards.text: And the rest of the dead? John says they don't come back to life until the thousand years are complete.

cards.question: Then John says, "This is the first ___."

cards.text: Then John says, "Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection!" Blessed AND holy, friend, that's a double batch.

cards.question: The second death has power over those who share in the first resurrection.
What will those who share in the first resurrection be as they reign with Christ?

answers.text: Priests of God and of Christ
Guards at the gates of the city

cards.text: When the thousand years are complete, Satan is released from his prison. A THOUSAND years, friend, and he walks straight out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog.

cards.question: Satan deceives the nations of Gog and Magog. What is he gathering them for?
John says the number of that gathered army is like the ___ of the seashore.

cards.text: That army marches across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounds the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And I used to think a junk drawer full of rubber bands was crowded.

cards.question: The camp of the saints and the beloved city are surrounded. Then what happens?

answers.text: Fire comes down from heaven and consumes them
The saints march out and drive them away
The army turns around and runs back home

cards.text: Then the devil, the one who deceived them, is thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur. Friend, THAT is a door I'm glad to see shut.

cards.question: When the devil is thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, he's the first one in there.
John says the devil, the beast and the false prophet will be tormented there for a thousand years and then it ends.

cards.text: Then John sees a great white throne and the One seated on it. And something flees from His presence.

cards.question: What flees from the presence of the One seated on the great white throne?

cards.text: John sees the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books are opened. Great AND small, friend: no front of the line, no back of the drawer.

cards.question: One of the books opened before the throne has a name: the Book of ___.
How are the dead judged before the great white throne?

answers.text: By their deeds recorded in the books
By their rank among the nations
By the land they were born in

cards.text: And nobody gets missed, friend. The sea gives up its dead.

cards.question: The sea gives up its dead, and ___ and ___ give up their dead too.

cards.text: Then Death and Hades themselves are thrown into the lake of fire. After years in a junk drawer waiting to get tossed out, I never thought I'd CHEER for something getting thrown away.

cards.question: John calls the lake of fire the second death.
At the great white throne, who is thrown into the lake of fire?

answers.text: Anyone not written in the Book of Life
Anyone who rose up out of the sea
Anyone who stood before the throne

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 15 quotes "This is the first ___.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The opening card says 'last time the beast and the false prophet got thrown alive into the fiery lake.' That assumes the baker did the previous lesson. The passage right before is context only, and Papa Dorin doesn't know what this baker has done before.

rule.text: **What he doesn't know:** anything about the individual baker that he hasn't been told, such as their streak, their mood, the time of day or how they've done before. In lessons, he's never told, because every baker gets the same lesson.

findings.problem: The opening card says the beast and the false prophet are already in the lake of fire. This gives away the answer to Stop 2 card 7, which asks whether the devil is the first one thrown into the lake (False).

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: Two of the wrong answers are 'The beast' and 'The false prophet.' Card 1 already told the baker that both were thrown into the fiery lake, so the setup rules them out and leaves only 'The dragon.'

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: The right answer 'Abyss' is the only capitalized option. The wrong answers 'temple' and 'storehouse' are lowercase, so the right answer stands out as a proper name.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.

findings.problem: The right answer 'For their testimony of Jesus' sounds biblical. The wrong answers 'For their refusal to pay taxes' and 'For their escape from prison' sound like everyday crimes, so the right answer stands out.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'Judges over the twelve tribes' can be argued right. Revelation 20:4, told on card 10, says those seated on the thrones 'had been given authority to judge,' so a baker could argue that those who reign are judges.

rule.text: **No near-matches.** A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

findings.problem: The joke 'THAT is a door I'm glad to see shut' mixes the image of a shut door with the lake of fire, which has no door. It doesn't click instantly.

rule.text:
3. One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting.
4. It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining.
5. If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it.

findings.problem: Card 11's line 'Great AND small, friend: no front of the line' tells the baker that rank doesn't matter. That rules out the wrong answer 'By their rank among the nations.'

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
